title: A Box, a Bin and a Bag
lines: Tim and Val have a big box.
"Can it be in a bin?" said Val.
Tim tips the box in. It can not fit in.
"A lot of bags are in the bin," said Val.
Tim digs in the bin and tips a bag up.
Tim tips the box up. It fits in the bin!
"It fits!" said Tim, and Val nods.
scoring_note: This passage says "can not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "can't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
